source_text: Ethically, advocates for Brit Shalom emphasize infant bodily autonomy and the principle of informed consent, viewing circumcision as a non-therapeutic alteration of healthy tissue that violates the child's right to an intact body, akin to arguments advanced in bioethics literature against irreversible procedures without medical necessity. [33]
